title: @rethunk/mcp-multi-root-git: git_log
description: Parameter schema for the 'git_log' MCP tool.

root.description: Repo path, array of paths, or "*" for all MCP roots.

format.description: `json` (default): groups array. `markdown`: headed sections per root. `oneline`: `<sha7> <subject>` per line; lowest-token option for post-commit verification.

since.description: Passed to `--since=`. ISO timestamp or git relative form (`48.hours`, `2.weeks.ago`). Default: `7.days`.

path.description: Limit to commits touching this path. Unioned with `paths`.

paths.description: Limit to commits touching these paths (max 256, `-- <paths>`).

grep.description: Filter by commit message regex (git `--grep`). Case-insensitive by default — see `ignoreCase`.

ignoreCase.description: Case-sensitivity of `grep` (`-i`). Default true (case-insensitive); set false for case-sensitive matching, aligning with `git_grep`'s case-sensitive-by-default pickaxe.

author.description: Filter by author name or email (`--author=`).

merges.description: `only`: merge commits only (`--merges`). `exclude`: no merge commits (`--no-merges`). Omit to include both.

maxCommits.description: Max commits per root (hard cap 500, default 50).

branch.description: Ref/branch to log from. Default: HEAD.

follow.description: Pass `git log --follow` for rename-aware history. Requires exactly one entry in `paths`.
